title: Django using Python
overview: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Django, a high-level Python web framework that simplifies web application development. Participants will learn how to build scalable, secure, and maintainable web applications using Django’s powerful features, including ORM (Object-Relational Mapping), authentication, middleware, REST APIs, and deployment. Hands-on projects will reinforce database-driven web development, security best practices, and integration with modern frontend frameworks.
audience: Python Developers looking to expand into web development
Backend Developers aiming to master Django for scalable applications
Full-Stack Developers building modern web applications
Software Engineers working on enterprise-level web solutions
Students & Professionals interested in web application development
methodology: Hands-on Coding Labs – Writing Django applications from scratch
Live Demonstrations – Implementing Django features in real-time
Case Studies & Real-World Examples – Understanding best practices
Collaborative Learning – Group projects and interactive discussions
Capstone Project – Developing a fully functional Django-based web application
competencies: Building Dynamic Web Applications using Python & Django
Database Management with Django ORM & PostgreSQL/MySQL
Developing REST APIs using Django REST Framework (DRF)
Deploying Django Applications on Cloud Platforms
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand Django’s architecture and core components
Build dynamic web applications with Django models, views, and templates
Work with databases using Django ORM
Develop RESTful APIs using Django REST Framework (DRF)
Implement authentication and user management in Django applications
Optimize Django applications for performance and scalability
Deploy Django applications to production environments
